responsibility: Generates Polonius `loan_invalidated_at` facts by replaying MIR accesses against the borrow set with borrow-checker conflict rules. It walks statements, terminators, rvalues, operands, and two-phase borrow activations, classifies each read, write, reservation, drop, call, yield, and other place access, and emits invalidation facts whenever an access would conflict with an in-scope borrow, including the special activation behavior of two-phase mutable borrows.
